subject.title: feat(canvas): widget design system — theme tokens, base styles, live host theme bridge

question: Should OpenClaw accept the deliberate temporary restyling of cached pre-token widgets in exchange for a single canonical themed host backdrop and live web theme bridge?
rationale: This is a visible compatibility and product-polish choice rather than a mechanical correctness question; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit human decision before automation proceeds.

options.title: Accept the transient cache tradeoff
options.body: After rebase and fresh proof, merge the canonical themed backdrop without a legacy white shim because the affected Canvas cache is transient and bounded.

options.title: Preserve the old cached appearance
options.body: Require a narrowly scoped compatibility presentation path for pre-token cached documents before merging, accepting the additional short-lived complexity.

recommendation.title: Accept the transient cache tradeoff
recommendation.body: After rebase and fresh proof, merge the canonical themed backdrop without a legacy white shim because the affected Canvas cache is transient and bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the available theme-bridge proposer and the strongest current routing signal for the UI product choice.
